name: dumbbell half kneeling military press
description: An overhead dumbbell press from a half kneeling stance, adding core and hip stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Switch your lead leg halfway through or on the next set.
